assets.reference: User-provided silver orb reference; not included in public repository.
assets.prompt:
Use case: background-extraction.
Asset type: one genuinely transparent PNG cutout of the supplied SE34 glass orb, for a website product carousel.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET. This is a faithful background-removal edit of the specific orb in that image, not a redesign or a new product.
Primary request: extract ONLY the single complete round glass orb, preserving exactly its shape, its neutral clear SILVER glass; do not introduce blue, purple, yellow or other colored tint, fluid swirling glass structure, silver streaks, transparent depth, refractions, embedded tiny bubbles, and the central round silver metallic badge. Preserve the badge's original placement, proportions and brushed metallic lighting. Preserve exactly the silver serif text "Se" on the upper line and "34" on the lower line — uppercase S, lowercase e, then 3 and 4. Do not change the lettering or the medallion.
Remove the entire outside background, all floor and ground reflection, all cast shadow underneath, all outside glow haze, and all peripheral words and branding outside the orb. The only visible text remaining must be the original "Se" and "34" on the orb's badge. Do not include any backdrop or caption.
Composition and consistent batch framing: output ONE square image canvas. Center the orb precisely, front-facing in the same orientation as the source. The COMPLETE circular silhouette must fit fully within the canvas, diameter about 86% of canvas width AND height, with approximately 7% fully transparent padding on every side. Match this standard scale for the six-color set. Do not crop its outer glass edge or enlarge the orb to touch the frame. No rotation or perspective change.
Transparency: actual alpha transparency outside the object's contour, not a painted checkerboard or black/white/gray background. Keep the crisp antialiased outer glass edge and the product's original glass highlights. Preserve the source's internal color, swirling form and material; do not wash out the orb, erase its dark internal refractions, or turn it into a flat disc. The central metal badge remains solid and readable.
Constraints: no newly invented objects, no extra sphere, no bottle, no stand, no floor, no jewelry loop, no chain, no hands, no new text, no watermark, no added border. Change only background removal and square-canvas framing; faithfully preserve the orb's existing color, shape, glass details and Se/34 identity.

observations: 完整轮廓、色彩、玻璃旋流、Se/34徽章保留。
外围文字、背景与地面倒影已去除。
真实alpha透明通道，边缘保留自然半透明反射。
透明边距约3–7%，略少于6–8%目标，实际边界已记录。
